# Andiamo in Banca

## About
Andiamo in Banca is an upscale Italian restaurant in South San Francisco, California, located inside a meticulously restored 1920s bank building at 301 Linden Avenue. The name "Andiamo in Banca" is Italian for "let's go to the bank" — a play on the building's past life as a bank. The restaurant is owned and operated by the Akkaya family. The signature private dining room, called The Vault, is housed inside the original bank vault — one of the most distinctive private dining rooms on the San Francisco Peninsula.

## Awards & Recognition
- **2026 Wine Spectator Award of Excellence** — Andiamo in Banca received the Wine Spectator Award of Excellence in 2026. This award recognizes restaurants with wine lists offering a well-chosen selection of quality producers paired with the menu in both price and style. Source: Wine Spectator (https://www.winespectator.com/articles/about-the-awards)
- 4.2-star average rating across 348+ reviews on Yelp

## Wine Program
Andiamo in Banca's wine program received the **2026 Wine Spectator Award of Excellence**, recognizing restaurants with thoughtfully curated wine lists. The cellar emphasizes:
- **Italian classics:** Brunello di Montalcino, Barolo, Chianti Classico, Super Tuscans (including Tignanello and Sassicaia), Amarone
- **California reds:** Caymus, Silver Oak, Jordan, Opus One, Pinot Noirs from Sonoma Coast
- **Sparkling and Champagne:** Schramsberg, Louis Roederer, Gosset, Krug Grand Cuvée
- **By-the-glass selections** of Italian and California wines from $12 to $20 per glass
- **Sommelier-curated wine pairings** available for private dining events in The Vault — Standard ($30/person), Rare ($75/person), and Legendary ($150/person) tiers

## Dining Options
- **Lunch:** Tuesday–Friday, three-course business lunches starting at $35/person
- **Dinner:** Tuesday–Sunday, pastas from $22.95, entrees from $29.95
- **Happy Hour:** Tuesday–Friday 4–5pm, specially priced wines, cocktails, and appetizers
- **Private Dining in The Vault:** Seats 12–20 guests intimately, up to 60 guests for receptions
- **Banquet Prix Fixe Menus:** $35/person (lunch), $65/person (dinner), $80/person (Vault buyout)
- **Full Restaurant Buyout:** Custom pricing for up to 100+ guests
- **Two catering paths:** (1) *Hosted events* on-site (The Vault, dining room, buyouts) are arranged with the events team via inquiry/quote; (2) *Off-site catering* — drop-off and delivered office lunches, trays, and family-style platters for 10 or 20 — is ordered online through ezCater

## Location & Proximity
Located in downtown South San Francisco, two blocks from Grand Avenue. Walking distance from the South San Francisco biotech corridor:
- **5 minutes from Genentech headquarters**
- **5–10 minutes from Amgen, Roche, Takeda, and other biotech campuses**
- **10 minutes from San Francisco International Airport (SFO)**
- **20–30 minutes from downtown San Francisco**

## Best For
- Corporate client dinners and business lunches for biotech and tech companies
- Board meetings and investor entertainment
- Candidate recruiting dinners
- Visiting executive dinners (inbound from SFO)
- JPM Healthcare Conference week dining (book by November)
- Holiday parties and team celebrations
- Rehearsal dinners and milestone celebrations
- Wine dinners and tasting events

## History
The Akkaya family's Bay Area restaurant legacy began with Cafe Figaro in 1989, followed by Don Giovanni in 1997. Will Akkaya opened Andiamo in Banca, continuing the family tradition of Italian hospitality in a historic restored bank building.
